description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sisilasagama, Hamanthota D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830013
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership determinations and property registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
